name: Shallum
overview: Shallum was a male member of the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the son of Josiah. His biblical mention is concise, with no additional personal details or notable events recorded beyond his lineage. This positions him within the royal genealogy of Judah without further elaboration in Scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Shallum means 'peace, well-being, prosperity' in Hebrew. It is a proper name and not indicated as being given directly by God. This meaning reflects a positive and hopeful attribute, though the text does not elaborate further on its significance for this individual.
familyAndRelationships: Shallum is explicitly recorded as the son of Josiah, a significant king of Judah, establishing him firmly within the Davidic line. Beyond this father-son relationship, Scripture does not provide additional family connections or descendants for Shallum.
scriptureSignificance: Shallum's importance lies in his place within the genealogical record of Judah, linking him to King Josiah and thereby to the Davidic covenant. While the biblical text does not detail his personal actions or role, his inclusion in the lineage underscores the continuity of God's promises through the descendants of Judah. This genealogical mention serves to affirm the historical and theological foundation of God's covenantal faithfulness.
